facts.statement: A compile-and-run validation command returned exit code 127 with output `g++: command not found`; the command result was returned directly to the task-solving agent.
After that command, the agent read and edited `solution.cpp`; the recorded edit changed sorting logic and did not install a compiler or execute an alternative compilation or runtime validation.
The final submission stated that the environment lacked `g++` and local compilation testing could not be completed.
The frozen evidence contains no successful compilation, successful execution, alternative compiler invocation, or substitute runtime validation after the exit-127 result.

claim_set.statement: An explicit task-validation failure signal was visible to the agent.
The agent acknowledged the missing compiler.
No successful recovery or substitute validation is recorded after the failure.

missing_facts: A successful compile/run or an alternative validation result after the failure.
